stem.text: The diagram shows two pairs X and Y of parallel forces.

stem.alt: Heading X. Two horizontal arrows, one above the other, with a vertical double-headed arrow labelled 50 cm to their left. The upper arrow is labelled 20 N and points right; the lower arrow is labelled 40 N and points left.

Heading Y. Two horizontal arrows, one above the other, with a vertical double-headed arrow labelled 50 cm to their left. The upper arrow is labelled 40 N and points left; the lower arrow is labelled 20 N and points right.

A.text: X is equivalent to a clockwise torque of $10\,\text{N m}$ and a force of $20\,\text{N}$ to the left.

B.text: X is equivalent to a clockwise torque of $20\,\text{N m}$ only.

C.text: Y is equivalent to an anticlockwise torque of $30\,\text{N m}$ and a force of $20\,\text{N}$ to the left.

D.text: Y is equivalent to an anticlockwise torque of $30\,\text{N m}$ only.
